source_refs.note: 6. Venturi Relation: a main subheading of 5.12 Uses of Bernoulli's principle, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 109-109.

blocks.text: Ek pipe lein jis mein density ρ wala fluid different (alag alag) cross-sectional areas se guzar raha hai (Fig. 5.22).
Chaure (wide) sire par cross-sectional area A₁ aur patle (narrow) hisse par A₂ hai.
Chaure aur patle hisson mein flow ki speeds v₁ aur v₂ hain. Manometer (pressure napne wali U-tube) ki dono limbs (baazu) jorne se dono hisson ka pressure P₁ aur P₂ maloom hota hai.

blocks.alt: Horizontal (zameen ke barabar leta hua) pipe: baen taraf chaura hissa A1, beech mein tang gala A2 aur daen phir chaura. Teen streamlines gale se guzarte hue qareeb aa jati hain; chaure hisse mein v1 aur gale mein v2. Neeche U-tube manometer chaure hisse aur gale ko jorta hai: chaure hisse ke neeche surface P1 neechi hai aur gale ke neeche surface P2 us se h oonchi.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.22: Venturi meter (kitab ki Figure 5.22 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Chaure hisse mein pressure P₁ zyada hai, is liye woh manometer ke liquid ko apni taraf zyada neeche dabata hai; throat mein speed zyada aur pressure P₂ kam hai, is liye wahan liquid h oonchai tak charh jata hai.
Pipe horizontal hai, is liye dono jagah average potential energy barabar hai (ρgh wali terms kat jati hain).
Is liye Bernoulli's equation yeh ban jati hai:

blocks.title: Interesting Information
blocks.text: Horizontal pipe ke liye Bernoulli's equation se saaf hai ke “jahan speed zyada ho, wahan pressure kam hota hai”. Mathematical shakal:

Figure se saaf hai ke A₂ < A₁, is liye v₁ v₂ ke muqable bohat chhota hai: chaure hisse mein fluid patle hisse se bohat aahista chalta hai. Is liye Eq. (5.25) ke daen hisse mein v₁ ko neglect (ignore) kar sakte hain:
Ise Venturi relation kehte hain. Yeh venturi meter mein istemal hoti hai, jo liquid ke flow (behna) ki speed napne ka device hai.
